provenance.notes: AUD-07 C13a corrected rule (pyramid side, matching G-DCA-SLIP-L-01): every exposure-increasing market order fills at its trigger price adverse-adjusted by the slippage. ATR 1; entry 100.02, stop 98.02, R 2, qty 5. Add 1 of 1 at 100.02 + 1 R = 102.02, frac 0.5 -> 2.5 at 102.02 x 1.0002 = 102.040404 (green candle 281 reaches 102.0201). Signal exit on the close of 283 at 102 x 0.9998 = 101.9796. pnl = 5 x (101.9796 - 100.02) + 2.5 x (101.9796 - 102.040404) - fees = 8.885966 (legacy slip-free add: 8.937002).
